## Additional Information

Please include anything else that might help diagnose the problem, such as:

* Whether restarting Starfin fixes the problem
* Whether restarting the Roku fixes the problem
* Whether the same media works in another Jellyfin client
* Whether the issue started after a Starfin or Jellyfin update
* Any unusual Jellyfin library or server configuration
* Relevant Jellyfin server logs

Please remove passwords, authentication tokens, public IP addresses, or other sensitive information from logs before posting them.
